observed_issue: CMS values required normalization rather than a literal lowercase match
reason: Prevent valid hospitals from being excluded because of coding format

observed_issue: Current CMS release uses Low, Medium, High, and Very high
revised_decision: Use the current ordered CMS categories
reason: Retain the published classification and avoid unsupported numeric assumptions

initial_plan: Include all hospital types and adjust using hospital type
observed_issue: Psychiatric, children's, federal, and long-term facilities have structurally different care systems
revised_decision: Restrict the primary cohort to acute-care and critical-access hospitals
reason: Improve comparability while retaining excluded types for transparent secondary analyses

initial_plan: Include rating in the primary adjustment set
observed_issue: Rating was missing for many hospitals and is itself a composite quality measure
revised_decision: Use rating only in a sensitivity model
reason: Preserve sample size and avoid overadjusting for a downstream quality construct
